# SplitButton

Split button: a primary action joined to a chevron that opens a menu of related actions. Composed from two children — a `Button` for the action and an `IconButton` (chevron) for the menu trigger — each carrying its own appearance, spacing and state; `SplitButton` only draws the seam between them and groups them for assistive tech.

**Import:** `import { SplitButton } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/SplitButton/SplitButton.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/SplitButton/SplitButton.stories.jsx` — Overview, Appearances, Spacing, MenuState, States, HoveredState, PressedState, KeyboardFocus, Interactive

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/forms-and-inputs/SplitButton/SplitButton.mdx`

## Usage

Use `SplitButton` when one action is clearly primary and a few related
actions belong beside it in a menu — "Send" with "Send and close," "Save" as
a draft. For actions with no clear primary, use `ButtonGroup` instead.

## Best practices

### Keep the two halves joined. {#keep-the-two-halves-joined}

The primary action and the menu trigger share one outline and one height.

Do: One outline around both halves.
Don't: Two separate buttons with a gap.

### The menu holds related actions only. {#the-menu-holds-related-actions-only}

Every menu item is a variation of the primary action: "Save", then "Save as draft" and "Save as template". "Delete account" or "Invite tutor" belong somewhere else.

### Put the common action on the face. {#put-the-common-action-on-the-face}

The half people use most sits on the face; the rarer ones go in the menu.

Do: "Save" on the face.
Don't: The rarely used "Save as template" on the face.

### Match appearance and spacing on both children yourself. {#match-appearance-and-spacing-on-both-children-yourself}

`SplitButton` draws the seam but sets no styling of its own. Pass the same
`appearance` and `spacing` to the `Button` and the chevron `IconButton` so
the control reads as one piece.

Do: Both halves use the primary appearance.
Don't: The two halves disagree on appearance, so they read as two controls.

```jsx
<SplitButton>
    <Button text="Send" onClick={send} appearance="primary" />
    <IconButton icon="chevron-down" label="More send options" appearance="primary" onClick={openMenu} />
</SplitButton>
```

### Open the menu from the chevron's own click handler. {#open-the-menu-from-the-chevron-s-own-click-handler}

`SplitButton` has no menu logic itself — wire the chevron's `onClick` to open
a `Popup` or `MenuGroup` positioned under it.

## Accessibility

- **A group of two controls.** The wrapper is `role="group"`, so
  assistive technology reads the action and its menu trigger as related. It
  has no name of its own; pass `aria-label` to give it one.
- **Each child keeps its own accessible name.** The primary action needs its
  own label; the chevron's `IconButton` needs a label describing what its
  menu holds, not a generic "more."

- For actions with no clear primary, use `ButtonGroup`.

## Parts

1. **Action.** A Button for the primary action.
2. **Seam.** The two children meet at a flat edge: inner corners are square, outer corners keep the button radius.
3. **Menu trigger.** An Icon button with a chevron that opens the related actions.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | Each child draws its own rest look; the seam joins them. |
| Hovered | Set independently on each child. |
| Pressed | Set independently on each child. |
| Focused | The focused child rises above its neighbor so its ring is not covered. |
| Disabled | Set independently on each child. |
| Loading | Set independently on each child. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Seam | 1: `--border-default`. A primary trigger draws it in `--ds-border-inverse`. |
| Outer corners | 6: `--button-radius-default`. Compact 4: `--button-radius-compact`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Label the main action with a verb and its object: "Publish page". | A bare "Go" or "More". |
| Name the menu trigger for what it opens: "More publish options". | "Menu", "Arrow" or "Chevron". |
| Use sentence case on both halves. | Title case or all capitals. |
| List the alternatives in the menu in the same voice as the main action: "Publish and notify". | Menu items that are not variations of the main action. |
